# openwrt_wireless_device (Resource)

A radio (`config wifi-device`). Radios are detected by the router, so this resource adopts an existing section and never deletes it.

Manages a `wifi-device` section in `/etc/config/wireless`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `acs_exclude_dfs` (Boolean) Exclude DFS channels from automatic selection. (UCI option `acs_exclude_dfs`.)
- `band` (String) Band. (UCI option `band`.) One of: `2g`, `5g`, `6g`, `60g`.
- `beacon_int` (Number) Beacon interval in TUs. (UCI option `beacon_int`.)
- `cell_density` (Number) Cell density: 0 disabled, 1 normal, 2 high, 3 very high. (UCI option `cell_density`.)
- `channel` (String) Channel number or `auto`. (UCI option `channel`.)
- `channels` (List of String) Channels allowed for automatic selection. (UCI option `channels`.)
- `country` (String) ISO/IEC 3166 alpha-2 country code. (UCI option `country`.)
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable the radio. (UCI option `disabled`.)
- `distance` (Number) Distance to the farthest station in meters. (UCI option `distance`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `htmode` (String) HT/VHT/HE/EHT mode, e.g. `HE80`. (UCI option `htmode`.)
- `legacy_rates` (Boolean) Allow legacy 802.11b rates. (UCI option `legacy_rates`.)
- `log_level` (Number) hostapd log level. (UCI option `log_level`.)
- `noscan` (Boolean) Do not scan for overlapping BSSs (forces 40MHz). (UCI option `noscan`.)
- `path` (String) Device path of the radio. (UCI option `path`.)
- `rts` (Number) RTS/CTS threshold. (UCI option `rts`.)
- `txpower` (Number) Transmit power in dBm. (UCI option `txpower`.)
- `type` (String) Driver type, normally `mac80211`. (UCI option `type`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
